summary.intent: Run the GSD plan-phase and execute-phase workflows end-to-end for Phase 45 ('Desktop FUSE write-durability cleanup'), a Rust-only hygiene refactor of the FUSE write-journal/replay code with 7 scope items and no behavior changes.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (6 plans across 5 waves, verification passed, all 7 scope items covered). Execution reached Wave 5 of 5 (5/6 plans complete) before the transcript ends — Plan 45-06 (journal_helpers.rs consolidation) was spawned but its result is not captured.

repo: The FUSE crate is `cipherbox-fuse` (default feature `fuse`), located at `crates/fuse/`; the workspace also contains `cipherbox-sdk` and `apps/desktop/src-tauri` as a consumer.
Pre-existing dead-code warnings in the vendored `fuser` ABI file (`fuse_abi.rs`) appear on every build and are unrelated to any changes in this phase.
Windows `mod.rs` inside `crates/fuse/src/fuse/windows/` is `cfg`-excluded on macOS, causing persistent rust-analyzer 'unlinked-file' diagnostics that are not real errors.
The API-surface extractor regex does not cover Rust — it returned 0 symbols for `cipherbox-fuse`, so the planner was invoked without an API surface artifact.
The commit helper script has a known false-negative bug: it returns `commit_failed` even when commits succeed; `git log` is the authoritative check.
Wave 1 was the only wave with genuine parallelism (45-01 and 45-02 have no file overlap); Waves 2–5 each touch `crates/fuse/src/lib.rs`, making them strictly serial.
43 fuse-crate tests and 48 sdk tests exist as of this phase; the characterization suite added in 45-01 brought the fuse count up from ~38.

code.finding: IDE showed E0308 type mismatch (expected Option<String>, found String) after 45-03's sentinel change — turned out to be stale rust-analyzer cache from the executor's mid-edit state; `cargo check --workspace` was clean.
A third duplicate of the journal-dir/max-retries constants was found here (beyond the two the plan expected) and cleaned up in 45-02.

workflow: rust-analyzer IDE diagnostics are unreliable during and immediately after subagent executor runs — always use `cargo check --workspace` as ground truth before escalating a reported compile error.
Running `cargo check --workspace` (not just the changed crate) is necessary after any type-signature change to catch downstream consumers breaking silently.

Choosing sequential on-branch execution over worktrees is correct when only one wave has parallelism and all subsequent waves share a single hot file (`lib.rs`); worktree overhead with no real benefit adds merge risk.
The GSD commit helper's false-negative on success is a known issue — verify completion with `git log` rather than trusting the helper's exit status.
Post-research artifact cleanup (marking `Open Questions` as `RESOLVED`, filling VALIDATION.md placeholders) should be done before the planner runs to avoid non-blocking checker warnings.

friction: Commit helper returned `commit_failed` on a successful commit (340e93efe), requiring a manual `git log` verification detour.
IDE diagnostics showed spurious E0308 compile errors after 45-03 due to stale rust-analyzer cache, prompting an unplanned `cargo check --workspace` verification loop.
The API surface extractor silently returned 0 results for Rust (regex not Rust-aware) — no error surfaced, so it had to be inferred from empty output.
VALIDATION.md was scaffolded with template placeholders that the plan-checker flagged as a non-blocking warning, requiring a post-verification edit pass to fill real `cargo test` commands.
open_items: Plan 45-06 (consolidate fuser/winfsp journal builders into `journal_helpers.rs`) was spawned but its result is not in the transcript — completion status unknown.
Phase-level verification and STATE/ROADMAP completion update (post all-waves gate) have not yet run — depends on 45-06 finishing.
